description: Tracked bash scripts over 150 lines that lint admits (ADR-040 §5 rule 2), each with the wave that ports it to Python: 1 the GitHub toolkit, 2 the guards, 3 bin/ and status, 4 the launcher, 5 provisioning, 6 the bash tests. The list only shrinks: a port removes its entry in the same pull request, and an entry the base branch does not have is a finding.
